description: XML standard for encoding archival finding aids, enabling detailed hierarchical description of archival collections. EAD3 consists of two major sections: control (administrative metadata about the finding aid) and archdesc (description of the archival materials).

entities.name: EAD
entities.description: Root element of an EAD3 document. Must contain control followed by archdesc, in that order.
entities.note: EAD3 root element. The two required children must appear sequentially: control first, then archdesc.

entities.name: Control
entities.description: Administrative metadata about the finding aid itself, replacing eadheader from EAD 2002. Contains record identifiers, file description, maintenance status/agency/history, and optional declarations.
entities.note: REQUIRED first child of ead. Must contain recordid, filedesc, maintenancestatus, maintenanceagency, and maintenancehistory.

entities.name: Record ID
entities.description: A required unique identifier for the EAD instance (finding aid). Corresponds to the recordid element.

entities.name: Other Record ID
entities.description: Alternative or additional identifiers for the finding aid from other systems. Corresponds to the otherrecordid element.

entities.name: Representation
entities.description: Links to alternate representations of the finding aid (e.g., HTML, PDF versions). Corresponds to the representation element.

entities.name: File Description
entities.description: Bibliographic information about the finding aid document. Must contain titlestmt. Corresponds to the filedesc element.

entities.name: Title Statement
entities.description: Title information for the finding aid, including the title proper, subtitle, author, and sponsor. Must contain at least titleproper. Corresponds to the titlestmt element.

entities.name: Edition Statement
entities.description: Information about the edition of the finding aid. Corresponds to the editionstmt element.

entities.name: Publication Statement
entities.description: Publication or distribution information for the finding aid. Corresponds to the publicationstmt element.

entities.name: Series Statement
entities.description: Information about the published series to which the finding aid belongs. Corresponds to the seriesstmt element.

entities.name: Note Statement
entities.description: General notes about the finding aid not covered by other elements. Corresponds to the notestmt element.

entities.name: Maintenance Status
entities.description: Current drafting status of the finding aid. The @value attribute is required. Corresponds to the maintenancestatus element.

entities.name: Publication Status
entities.description: Publication status of the finding aid. Corresponds to the publicationstatus element.

entities.name: Maintenance Agency
entities.description: Institution or service responsible for the creation, maintenance, and/or dissemination of the finding aid. Corresponds to the maintenanceagency element.
entities.note: REQUIRED child of control. Must contain agencyname.

entities.name: Language Declaration
entities.description: Declares the language and script used in the finding aid (not the archival materials). Repeatable for multilingual finding aids. Corresponds to the languagedeclaration element.

entities.name: Convention Declaration
entities.description: Declares the rules or conventions applied in creating the finding aid (e.g., DACS, ISAD(G), RDA). Corresponds to the conventiondeclaration element.

entities.name: Rights Declaration
entities.description: Declares the rights and permissions associated with the finding aid (not the archival materials). New in EAD3. Corresponds to the rightsdeclaration element.

entities.name: Local Type Declaration
entities.description: Declares locally-defined types used in @localtype attributes throughout the finding aid. Corresponds to the localtypedeclaration element.

entities.name: Local Control
entities.description: Provides locally-defined controlled access terms for the finding aid. Corresponds to the localcontrol element.

entities.name: Maintenance History
entities.description: Documents the history of the creation and maintenance of the finding aid. Contains one or more maintenance events. Corresponds to the maintenancehistory element.
entities.note: REQUIRED child of control. Must contain at least one maintenanceevent.

entities.name: Maintenance Event
entities.description: Records a single creation, modification, or other maintenance action performed on the finding aid. Must contain eventtype, eventdatetime, agenttype, and agent in that order. Corresponds to the maintenanceevent element.
entities.note: REQUIRED within maintenancehistory. All four child elements are required.

entities.name: Sources
entities.description: References to source materials used in creating the finding aid. Corresponds to the sources element.

entities.name: Archival Description
entities.description: Core intellectual description of the archival materials. Must begin with a did (descriptive identification) element. The @level attribute is required. Corresponds to the archdesc element.
entities.note: REQUIRED second child of ead. @level is required. Must contain did as its first descriptive element.

entities.name: Description Identification
entities.description: Binds together core identifying information about the archival materials: title, identifier, dates, extent, repository, creator, language, and abstract. Corresponds to the did element.
entities.note: REQUIRED first child of archdesc and each component. At minimum should include unittitle and unitid.

entities.name: Unit Title
entities.description: Title of the described materials. May include dates and name sub-elements. Corresponds to the unittitle element.

entities.name: Unit ID
entities.description: Reference code or identifier for the described materials. Corresponds to the unitid element.

entities.name: Unit Date
entities.description: Date or date range of the described materials, expressed as a text string. Corresponds to the unitdate element.

entities.name: Unit Date Structured
entities.description: Machine-processable date or date range of the described materials. New in EAD3. Contains datesingle, daterange, or dateset sub-elements. Corresponds to the unitdatestructured element.

entities.name: Physical Description
entities.description: Free-text statement of the physical characteristics and extent of the described materials. Corresponds to the physdesc element.

entities.name: Physical Description Structured
entities.description: Machine-processable structured physical description using quantity, unittype, physfacet, and dimensions. New in EAD3. Corresponds to the physdescstructured element.

entities.name: Physical Description Set
entities.description: Groups multiple physdescstructured elements using parallel or coverage attributes. New in EAD3. Corresponds to the physdescset element.

entities.name: Physical Location
entities.description: Information identifying the physical location of the described materials. Corresponds to the physloc element.

entities.name: Repository
entities.description: Institution or agency responsible for providing intellectual access to the described materials. Corresponds to the repository element.

entities.name: Origination
entities.description: Creator or source of the described materials. Contains name elements (persname, corpname, famname, or name). Corresponds to the origination element.

entities.name: Person Name
entities.description: Name of a person, used in origination, controlaccess, and other contexts. Contains one or more part sub-elements. Corresponds to the persname element.

entities.name: Corporate Name
entities.description: Name of a corporate body or organization. Corresponds to the corpname element.

entities.name: Family Name
entities.description: Name of a family. Corresponds to the famname element.

entities.name: Language of Material
entities.description: Language(s) and script(s) of the described archival materials. May contain language and languageset sub-elements. Corresponds to the langmaterial element.

entities.name: Abstract
entities.description: Brief summary of the described materials, including scope, content, and biographical/historical context. Corresponds to the abstract element.

entities.name: Container
entities.description: Identifies the physical housing (box, folder, volume, etc.) of the described materials. Corresponds to the container element.

entities.name: Material Specific Details
entities.description: Information unique to specific types of materials (e.g., cartographic, musical). Corresponds to the materialspec element.

entities.name: Digital Archival Object
entities.description: Links to a born-digital or digitized archival object. Uses @href to point to the digital object and @daotype to specify born digital or derived. Corresponds to the dao element.

entities.name: Digital Archival Object Set
entities.description: Groups multiple related digital archival objects. New in EAD3. Corresponds to the daoset element.

entities.name: DID Note
entities.description: General note within the descriptive identification section. Corresponds to the didnote element.

entities.name: Scope and Content
entities.description: Summary of the range and topical coverage of the described materials, including content types and dates. Corresponds to the scopecontent element.

entities.name: Biographical/Historical Note
entities.description: Biographical sketch or administrative history of the creator of the described materials. Corresponds to the bioghist element.

entities.name: Custodial History
entities.description: Information about the chain of ownership and custody of the described materials prior to their acquisition. Corresponds to the custodhist element.

entities.name: Acquisition Information
entities.description: Information about how the described materials were acquired by the repository. Corresponds to the acqinfo element.

entities.name: Arrangement
entities.description: Information about the organization and arrangement of the described materials. Corresponds to the arrangement element.

entities.name: Access Restrictions
entities.description: Conditions governing access to the described materials. Corresponds to the accessrestrict element.

entities.name: Use Restrictions
entities.description: Conditions governing the use of the described materials after access has been granted. Corresponds to the userestrict element.

entities.name: Physical Characteristics and Technical Requirements
entities.description: Information about physical characteristics or technical requirements that affect use of the described materials. Corresponds to the phystech element.

entities.name: Legal Status
entities.description: Legal status or nature of the described materials. Corresponds to the legalstatus element.

entities.name: Appraisal
entities.description: Information about the appraisal or evaluation of the described materials. Corresponds to the appraisal element.

entities.name: Accruals
entities.description: Information about anticipated additions to the described materials. Corresponds to the accruals element.

entities.name: Processing Information
entities.description: Information about actions taken by the repository in preparing the described materials for use. Corresponds to the processinfo element.

entities.name: Alternative Form Available
entities.description: Information about alternative formats in which the described materials exist (e.g., microfilm, digital copies). Corresponds to the altformavail element.

entities.name: Location of Originals
entities.description: Information about the location of originals when the repository holds copies. Corresponds to the originalsloc element.

entities.name: Related Material
entities.description: Information about materials related to the described materials that are not physically or logically part of them. Corresponds to the relatedmaterial element.

entities.name: Separated Material
entities.description: Information about materials that have been separated from the described materials and are now held elsewhere. Corresponds to the separatedmaterial element.

entities.name: Other Finding Aid
entities.description: Information about other finding aids to the described materials. Corresponds to the otherfindaid element.

entities.name: Bibliography
entities.description: Citations to works based on or about the described materials. Corresponds to the bibliography element.

entities.name: Preferred Citation
entities.description: The preferred form of citation for the described materials. Corresponds to the prefercite element.

entities.name: File Plan
entities.description: Information about the classification scheme or file plan of the described materials. Corresponds to the fileplan element.

entities.name: Other Descriptive Data
entities.description: Descriptive information not covered by other EAD elements. Corresponds to the odd element.

entities.name: Controlled Access Headings
entities.description: Groups controlled vocabulary access terms for indexing and retrieval. Contains name, subject, and other access point elements. Corresponds to the controlaccess element.

entities.name: Subject
entities.description: Subject heading from a controlled vocabulary. Corresponds to the subject element.

entities.name: Geographic Name
entities.description: Geographic name heading from a controlled vocabulary. Corresponds to the geogname element.

entities.name: Genre/Form
entities.description: Genre or physical form heading. Corresponds to the genreform element.

entities.name: Function
entities.description: Access term for a function or activity that generated the described materials. Corresponds to the function element.

entities.name: Occupation
entities.description: Occupation access term. Corresponds to the occupation element.

entities.name: Title
entities.description: Title access term for a related work. Corresponds to the title element within controlaccess.

entities.name: Index
entities.description: Index to the described materials. Corresponds to the index element.

entities.name: Description of Subordinate Components
entities.description: Wrapper for hierarchical components (c/c01-c12) that describe sub-units of the archival materials. Corresponds to the dsc element.

entities.name: Component
entities.description: A hierarchical component representing a sub-unit of the archival materials (series, subseries, file, item, etc.). Can be unnumbered (c) or numbered (c01-c12). Contains a required did plus optional descriptive elements and child components. Corresponds to c/c01-c12 elements.
entities.note: Recursive nesting creates the multi-level hierarchy. Each component must contain a did. The @level attribute is optional but recommended.

levelsOfDescription.collection: Artificial accumulation of documents assembled by a common theme, person, or source
levelsOfDescription.fonds: Whole of the records of an organization, family, or individual
levelsOfDescription.series: Documents arranged in accordance with a filing system or maintained as a unit
levelsOfDescription.file: Organized unit of documents grouped together for use or filing
levelsOfDescription.class: A grouping of material resulting from a classification process
levelsOfDescription.otherlevel: Level not covered by the controlled list (specify in @otherlevel)

maintenanceStatusValues.cancelled: Finding aid instance was cancelled before publication
maintenanceStatusValues.deleted: Finding aid instance has been deleted from the system
maintenanceStatusValues.deletedmerged: Finding aid has been deleted and merged into another record
maintenanceStatusValues.deletedreplaced: Finding aid has been deleted and replaced by another record
maintenanceStatusValues.deletedsplit: Finding aid has been deleted and split into multiple records
maintenanceStatusValues.derived: Finding aid derived from another descriptive system

publicationStatusValues.inprocess: In process, not yet approved for publication

maintenanceEventTypes.derived: Finding aid was derived from another source

agentTypes.human: A person performed the maintenance action

dateTypes.bulk: Bulk dates (predominant dates of the materials)
dateTypes.inclusive: Inclusive dates (earliest to latest dates of the materials)

daoTypes.borndigital: Content originally created in digital form
daoTypes.derived: Content derived from a physical original (e.g., digitized)

coverageValues.whole: Represents the entirety of the described unit
coverageValues.part: Represents only a portion of the described unit

physDescStructuredCoverage.whole: Physical description applies to all materials at this level
physDescStructuredCoverage.part: Physical description applies to some materials at this level
